svg.aria-label: Fruti Pop genuine smiles desktop variation
svg.script: (()=>{const messages=[["Hey, I’m","DJ Pop!"],["Ready to pop?"],["Pick your","flavour!"],["Feeling lucky?","Go mystery!"]];const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');let i=0,t;function change(){document.querySelectorAll('.comment').forEach(el=>{const x=el.dataset.x,y=+el.dataset.y,gap=+el.dataset.gap,lines=messages[i];el.style.fontSize=el.closest("svg").dataset.comments==="mobile"&&lines[0].length>12?"12px":"";el.replaceChildren();lines.forEach((line,n)=>{const s=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','tspan');s.setAttribute('x',x);s.setAttribute('y',lines.length===1?y+gap/2:y+n*gap);s.textContent=line;el.appendChild(s)});if(!reduced.matches&&el.animate)el.animate([{opacity:0,transform:'scale(.96) translateY(2px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'scale(1.02)',offset:.7},{opacity:1,transform:'scale(1)'}],{duration:360,easing:'ease-out'})})}function schedule(){clearTimeout(t);if(!document.hidden&&!reduced.matches)t=setTimeout(()=>{i=(i+1)%messages.length;change();schedule()},6000)}document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',schedule);reduced.addEventListener('change',schedule);document.querySelectorAll('.menu-toggle').forEach(el=>{const toggle=()=>{const panel=el.closest('svg').querySelector('.menu-panel'),open=panel.style.display==='none';panel.style.display=open?'block':'none';el.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));el.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close navigation':'Open navigation')};el.addEventListener('click',toggle);el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggle()}})});schedule()})();
